method: Read all271 definition-of-done and final-rule propositions, all54 full context profiles and11 exact caption occurrence sets. The exact deployed-commit umbrella through base5505 is preserved for all governed duties. Every full payload is compared with immutable predecessor evidence and all2550 old occurrence bindings are transported exactly. No referenced code, test implementation, device record or proof result was opened.

Subsequent category captions do not release that build binding. A retained context is not a claim that all children are unchanged; each child is independently adjudicated. Repository-only trace evidence remains outside runtime content.

This preserves a manifest schema obligation, not any old identity for changed content or completeness of an old manifest. Full current coverage and omission challenge remain required.

Actual accepted validity, current matrix and sufficiency domains change separately. F2 supplies no hidden-independence or successful-execution proof.

C1 leaves response transport separate from intake recursion; D primitive parsing is not this response-parser step. Complete current validation/derivation/gating is separately changed.

No actual result or implementation conformance is claimed.

Exact original occurrence provenance and stable identities for unchanged content remain, while changed content needs fresh identity. A fixed schema/owner does not preserve an old complete denominator. Omission challenge, distinct reconciliation and conditional inherited references remain.

Accounting is not semantic inspection, inaccessible content is not zero and inherited decoder details remain conditional.

A fixed formula or existing link cannot establish current completeness. Mandatory membership, independent evidence and conditional source limits remain explicit.

Empty-universe admission remains independently evidenced, not vacuous; missing proof or UNKNOWN availability cannot erase its own obligation. Initial authoring is not accepted review.

Affected-field names do not confer writes; later receipts cannot redefine tests or retirement. Existing direct commands need no artificial approval, while required human acceptance remains mandatory.

Attributable external echoes support only their stated basis; no hidden independence or observed external possession is implied.

F2 native routes require observed exact custody before start; external echo support does not manufacture missing bytes. Exact original byte verification and qualified decoder/binding dependencies remain.
decisions.NORMALIZED_VARIANCE_AND_STABILITY: Actual stability reconciliation uses current B due population, D results, E complete normalized frozen variance and applicable F1/F2 inputs; unchanged arithmetic cannot retain old values. The separate visibility-only atom6911 is corrected below. Frozen identity does not by itself establish semantic approval; no failed/unknown run may be omitted.
decisions.CURRENT_PERSISTED_INTAKE: Complete accepted current intake committed, reloaded or consumed downstream contains A validated fallback/answer context, C/C1 complete provenance/accounting and F2 admitted input support. Atomicity, no repeated resupply and durable reuse persist; an old pointer/reload facility does not establish complete current content.
decisions.CURRENT_HANDOFF_AND_RETURN_DISCLOSURE: Actual current handoff/export/required returns reflect C/C1 exact source members, A/B/D/E current response contracts and applicable F1/F2 target/input context. Exact prompt bytes, named slots and no automatic transfer remain; C1 does not recursively expand inbound responses or authorize early future-material access.
decisions.HUMAN_CONVERSATION_AND_CONFIRMATION: Current mode and required confirmed-answer validation uses A exact request/answer and blocking/lifecycle rules with relevant C/C1 content. The two structural raw-input/conversation lifecycle atoms are corrected below because A expressly governs final fallback rather than normal conversation. No unconfirmed answer gains authority and confirm-without-retyping remains.
decisions.ACTUAL_VALIDATION_DERIVATION_AND_NEXT_AC: Actual current validation/proposal/derivation/gate/blocker and next due action must implement applicable A–F2 predicates. Exact lifecycle order and preceding original occurrences remain. An unchanged command/UI label does not preserve current readiness or invalid-answer semantics; unknown inputs cannot be announced as completed.
decisions.CURRENT_CANDIDATE_INSPECTION: Current accepted external inspection of the exact frozen Stage25 candidate also meets A response admission and F2 exact input support alongside original actual representation evidence and independence. Stage28 cannot substitute another set; echoes and byte equality alone do not prove semantic inspection.
decisions.CURRENT_IDENTITY_INPUT_AND_ADMISSIBILITY: These obligations require actual current identity/selection/coverage/admissibility computations, now including C/C1 occurrences, A/B/E values, D semantic identities and F1/F2 execution/input context. They do not merely assign a module owner. Canonical algorithms persist while current complete values require fresh evaluation.
decisions.WHOLE_IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETION: The whole current contract and boundary implementation/live behavior/deployed verification/regression/failure/reload duty now includes applicable amended behavior. All30 stages, exact deployed bytes, visual baseline and visible live path remain required. No implementation/test/device result is read or accepted by this source determination.
decisions.CURRENT_RELEASE_SEMANTIC_REVIEW: Current release-bearing semantic values include B availability proof and E normalized variance under original independent semantic review plus applicable A/F2 response/input admission. Independence is not replaced by echoes; authoring or freezing is not accepted semantic truth. Distinct reconciliation and explicit unresolved dispositions persist.
decisions.CORRECTION_6911: Base5437 requires variance and defects to remain visible; it does not define a variance value, normalizer or sufficiency threshold. Base2709–2716 likewise requires exposing unexplained variance without inventing release thresholds. E changes the current normalized variance object and stability computations, which must still satisfy this unchanged visibility predicate. Retain visibility, without retaining an old object, value, interpretation or proof.
decisions.CORRECTION_6942: Base5476–5477 requires raw human input after project creation. C explicitly treats later unitization as structural accounting of exact retained originating input (successor424–426), not a replacement raw-input format; A applies to final humanInputRequests fallback. This lifecycle step and predecessor order remain. Actual enumeration, accounting and complete committed intake are independently changed.
decisions.CORRECTION_6946: Base5480–5481 requires Stage01 human conversation after export of the exact prompt/files. Base1523–1533 preserves conversational questions and expressly distinguishes humanInputRequests as final structured fallback, not normal conversation. A closes that fallback and its SAVE lifecycle, and C supplies structural accounting, neither redefining the conversational lifecycle step. Current exported content, answer validation/confirmation and conversation-mode derivation remain separately changed.
